verdict.rationale:
QuickBooks Online exposes a documented public REST API (V3) with official SDKs (Node.js OAuth client, PHP SDK) supporting full CRUD operations, and Intuit even ships an official MCP server exposing 145 tools covering the full QBO API surface for CRUD on 29 entity types and 11 reports, explicitly documented for Claude Code/MCP-compatible clients. This is strong, first-party evidence that an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically via a documented public API rather than only a UI.

Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (probes for these returned 404s), and independent/community hands-on confirmation of the MCP server or REST API's reliability in production use.
